title: Inguinal Canal: Hernia Landmarks and Clinical Anatomy
subject: Anatomy
preview: The inguinal canal conveys the spermatic cord in males and round ligament in females, with the ilioinguinal nerve traversing part of it.
quickRevision: The inguinal canal conveys the spermatic cord in males and round ligament in females, with the ilioinguinal nerve traversing part of it.
Identify the inguinal ligament, deep and superficial rings and posterior wall when interpreting groin anatomy.
Femoral hernias pass below the inguinal ligament and carry important strangulation risk.

sections.title: Core biomedical mechanism
points: The inguinal canal conveys the spermatic cord in males and round ligament in females, with the ilioinguinal nerve traversing part of it.
An indirect inguinal hernia enters the deep ring lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels; a direct hernia projects medially through Hesselbach triangle.

sections.title: Clinical application

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: A lump's relation to the inferior epigastric vessels is an anatomical distinction, not safely established by surface examination alone.

quiz.question: An indirect inguinal hernia lies on which side of inferior epigastric vessels?
quiz.explanation: An indirect inguinal hernia enters the deep ring lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels; a direct hernia projects medially through Hesselbach triangle.
